page.overview:
Who is Steve Gallacci?

Steve Gallaci was a Starfleet officer of the 24th century. His serial number was FSN 682-58-1047.

In 2364, he was a professor aboard the . On or about stardate 41044.2, according to an order sent by Commodore Bill Marafe of Starbase 55, he was scheduled for a transfer to the . (, okudagram)
